title: Validate a heat-exchanger model on unseen conditions
equipment: Plate heat exchanger with local, cold-flow-load, and high-flow validation copies
physicalPurpose: Bound the purpose and operating region of a frozen local model before it supports controller design.
principalTechnique: Independent holdout validation, uncertainty coverage, residual diagnosis, and bounded model scope
objective: Classify one frozen model as accepted, restricted, or rejected on independent amplitude, disturbance, and operating-point evidence.

simplifications: Each record isolates one declared validation condition
The frozen candidate has one gain, lag, and delay and no cold-flow input
Parameter intervals and 0.30 degC measurement-noise allowance are frozen before validation

baseline.limitation: Estimation fit and interval width cannot establish prediction on unseen amplitude, disturbance, or operating-point data.

change.decision: Issue separate accepted, restricted, and rejected purpose-and-region verdicts without refitting or averaging incompatible windows.

disturbances: A minus-2-degC cold-flow equilibrium shift at 90 s on one copy
A separate high-flow copy with 0.25 degC/% gain

abortPredicates: Any required sample, prediction, residual, or timestamp is nonfinite
Quality is invalid or timing has a gap
A frozen structure, parameter, interval, preprocessing rule, or threshold changes
A valve clips or saturates or temperature leaves the declared region
safety.restorationMode: Set ExperimentEnabled false and restore every simulated valve to 20 percent
safety.physicalApprovalRole: authorised process controls engineer and heat-exchanger operator
simulationOnlyRestrictions: Simulation validation cannot be presented as physical-plant evidence
Physical validation requires independently reviewed topology, process hazards, conditions, roles, and immediate approval

video.viewerOutcome: Accept, restrict, or reject a frozen model from independent evidence and carry its supported scope into design.

learning.context: Three independent plate-heat-exchanger records test a frozen local FOPDT model under local, omitted-load, and high-flow conditions.
learning.reason: Qualified estimation data and low fit error do not prove prediction on unseen amplitudes, disturbances, or operating points.
theory: Immutable holdout data test a frozen model and cannot be reused to alter it.
RMSE, bias, lag-one residual correlation, uncertainty-envelope width, and coverage expose different prediction failures.
Confidence belongs to the interval procedure and does not turn a local estimate into global plant truth.
Accepted, restricted, and rejected verdicts always name purpose and validity region.
learning.workedPrediction: Predict local 2.5 degC equilibrium and 1.58 degC one-time-constant movement, minus-2 degC load bias, and minus-1.25 degC high-flow bias.
practicalPreparation: Verify Simulation provenance, frozen model and intervals, distinct run identities, signals, units, quality, timing, limits, operating points, and restoration.
Freeze predictions, windows, metrics, thresholds, and no-refit rule before enabling the holdout step.
learning.baseline: Review the Lesson 40 estimation fit and explain why same-record error is not independent validation.
learning.change: Apply one new 5-point input to three declared conditions and replay every applied input through the unchanged model and interval corners.
learning.comparison: Keep local, pre-load, post-load, and high-flow windows separate while comparing residual error, structure, and envelope coverage.
learning.validation: Accept local command prediction, restrict the model from cold-flow prediction, and reject it at the high-flow operating point using predeclared gates.
learning.explanation: Passing local evidence confirms interpolation; systematic load and high-flow residuals expose missing input structure and operating-point-dependent gain.
learning.transfer: Carry the accepted purpose, restrictions, rejected regions, uncertainty, and failed criteria into every later tuning or design decision.
